game_concept: A speed quiz set in Sand Dunes – Merchant Waystation, a waystation for merchants: the scarab scholar must handle giant scorpions while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Off By One Autopsy: Diagnose off-by-one failures in loops and indexes in a broken script.
theme: Sand Dunes – Merchant Waystation: a waystation for merchants
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Build a flowchart that reads a and b, adds them, and displays their sum. Test dataset 1: {'a': 1, 'b': 3}; {'a': 0, 'b': 2}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Off By One Autopsy' (Week 9 slot 6), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Merchant Waystation'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Collect 130 points of trade goods by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
source_lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 130, or lives reach 0.
source_game_title: Off By One Autopsy – Merchant Waystation Rush
hint: Coordinates begin at the top left. Walls block movement. Use int declarations, observe(value), movement calls, and { } for local scope.
